## 20 Trade and Other Receivables

Trade receivables are non interest-bearing and are generally on 30-90 day payment terms depending on the geographical ter    s  o e   e    e es   lue. During the year-ended 31 March 2019 a provision for impairment of $0.6M [2018: $0.6M] was recognised in operating expenses against receivables.
